title: Supernatural power given to the will
source_text: XXVI. Addunt & hoc ad exaggerandam omnimodo gratiam, etiam supernaturalem potentiam voluntati conferri, & hac ratione Deum immediate in voluntatem agere, modo illa actio voluntatem non necessitet antecedenter, & libertatem potentiamque non volendi tollat.
pass_a_gloss: XXVI. They add this too to magnify grace in every way, that supernatural power also is conferred on the will, & in this way God acts immediately on the will, provided that action does not necessitate the will antecedently, & take away the liberty & power of not willing.
pass_b_english: Thesis XXVI. To magnify grace in every way they add that a supernatural power is also given to the will, and that in this way God acts directly on the will, so long as that action does not necessitate the will beforehand or remove its freedom and its power of not willing.

lemmas.gloss: to magnify grace in every way
God acts immediately on the will

lemmas.latin: modo illa actio voluntatem non necessitet antecedenter
lemmas.gloss: provided that action does not necessitate the will antecedently

choices.why: The Remonstrant term: grace acts so that the will can either yield to it or block it.

bible_refs: The same Remonstrant declaration, p. 16 (as cited in the print: 'the following page').
